title: Below Zero-Arctic Wasteland
description: A world of cold.Snow everywhere, and something else...
body:
In this ModPack,\
you will feel cold, and alone.

A vast desert of snow and ice,\
waiting for you, to thrive in a place no one else could survive.

To make the world get like that click this link to find out how:\
https://modrinth.com/mod/ice-age-frozen-world

Features:

- Snow everywhere
- Temprature meter
- Shader compatibility

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
